role: Characterization XCTest suite for RRCollector's observable surface: ArchiveSignal coalesced version bumps, back-compat forwarding to DeviceStatus/StreamingLifecycle/MorningCoordination/SessionState sub-observables, resetSession, MorningProcessingStatus equality, ANS config and paused-session lookup.
types: RRCollectorObservableStateTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over RRCollector sub-observables
state: collector: lazy var RRCollector built on first access with the designated init: a new PolarManager, the host's HealthKitManager, a SessionArchive in storageDirectory and a BaselineTracker on storageDirectory/HRVBaseline.json; settings, CloudKit sync and background audio default to the host's shared instances
storageDirectory: nonisolated let temp dir RRCollectorObservableState-<UUID> (created in setUp, removed in tearDown)
cancellables: Set<AnyCancellable> (reset in setUp/tearDown, never used by any test)
toplevel: lazy collector property defers RRCollector construction until first use so setUp's clearPersistedState runs first, and keeps its archive and baseline in this test's temporary directory; cancellables is declared and cleared but no test subscribes anything.

units.does: Clears persisted recording state: PersistedRecordingState.clear() plus removal of the three legacy RRCollector.activeRecording* UserDefaults keys.
XCTest setUp: clears persisted recording state, resets cancellables and creates the test's temporary storage directory before each test.
units.entry: XCTest runner: setUp before each test

units.does: XCTest tearDown: clears cancellables, deletes the lazy collector's currentSession from its temporary archive if one is set (error ignored with try?), clears persisted recording state, then removes the temporary storage directory (a failure fails the test).
units.entry: XCTest runner: tearDown after each test
